div.head: IV Atr 8
div.ab: Et rex suadet et mandat episcopis suis et comitibus et aldremannis et prepositis omnibus, ut curam adhibeant de illis qui tale falsum operantur et portant per patriam, sicut premissum est, utrobique cum Danis et Anglis.

Et rex suadet et mandat episcopis suis et comitibus et aldremannis et praepositis omnibus, ut curam adhibeant de illis qui tale falsum operantur et portant per patriam, sicut praemissum est, utrobique cum Danis et Anglis.

And the king advises and commands his bishops and earls and ealdormen and all his reeves that, both among the Danes and the English, they be on the watch for those who coin such base money and spread it abroad through the country, as has been stated above.

Und der König empfiehlt und gebietet seinen Bischöfen und Earls und Ealdormen und allen Vögten, dass sie überall bei Dänen und Engländern auf jene Acht haben, welche solch falsches [Geld] herstellen und durchs Land bringen, wie oben gesagt ist.

And the king urges and commands his bishops and earls and ealdormen and all reeves that they keep watch everywhere, among Danes and English, on those who make such false [money] and bring it through the country, as was said above.
